synthesisCountsAnswer.question: What do the reported high synthesis counts represent?
synthesisCountsAnswer.answer: Durable synthesis operations in instances/<agent>/runtime/brain-operations; for jerry/forrest each counted op made ~exactly one real provider call (provider_selected -> provider_call_terminal). They are neither mere attempts nor per-op retry inflation. The spike (jerry 08-15..08-19: 37/55/66/88/97 per day) was ~72% trigger='manual' from an every-30-min freshness exec cron whose bare POST + poll-timeout + scheduler catch-up/repair re-runs (523 runs, 200 errors, peak 185/day) stacked concurrent ops; with admission-time dedup absent (requestId-only idempotency) and commit protected only by compare-and-swap on a fast-moving brain revision, 217 in-window jerry calls completed at the provider and were then discarded source_changed. Committed products: jerry 50, forrest 109, grokbot 0 (window). The meta-coordinator never triggers brain-state synthesis (its same-named mechanism spawns a specialist mission agent). Interval timer contributes 'scheduled' (3h, dashboard, runOnStart disabled); the 5h stale guard contributes 'auto_scheduled' (engine, 30-min sampling, 4h in-process rate limit that resets on restart and is bypassed on ENOENT).
